verdict.rationale: Supabase documents a Management API for managing organizations and projects programmatically, backed by a live OpenAPI spec. Its official hosted MCP server lets agents query the database and manage migrations, and probes confirm that endpoint is live and speaks OAuth. The CLI runs keylessly and captures schema changes as migration files, so create, apply-schema, and query steps are all reachable without the dashboard. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that a hosted project can be created via API, CLI, or MCP (the docs only say 'manage projects'); a documented programmatic way to fetch the connection string; and hands-on or independent confirmation of the full end-to-end flow.
